visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a hand holding a black iPhone 14 Pro. (2) The camera cuts to a young woman with a short black bob haircut wearing a white thin-strap dress. She is in a bright indoor studio with shelves and plants in the background. She smiles broadly, points at the phone, and looks directly at the lens. (3) The view shifts back to a series of close-ups of the phone's E-ink screen. The display transitions between different black-and-white or high-contrast color photos of various K-pop idols. Hands are seen tilting the phone to catch the light, emphasizing the matte texture. (4) A screen recording of a mobile application named 'InkCase' is shown. The interface is white and blue, featuring a 'DIY phone case' title. Fingers are seen tapping on 'Quick Edit' and navigating through a photo gallery filled with selfies and idol photos. She holds the phone close to her face, then flips it around to reveal a new image of herself on the back display. She sticks out her tongue and winks while holding the device steady.
